name: Gelkis Alliance
summary: In southwest Desolace, Gurda Wildmane turns the centaur clans' hatred toward their defeat. Befriend one clan to learn how the others may be beaten. The Gelkis demand that you kill their hated enemies, the Magram, before you meet Uthek the Wise at Gelkis Village.

sections.title: Hatred as a Weapon
sections.body: Gurda Wildmane means to turn the centaur clans' hatred against them. Befriend one clan, and what you learn may show how to defeat them all. Choose the Gelkis. To earn their respect, kill the Magram, the clan they hate most.

sections.title: The Shaman
sections.body: Once the Gelkis respect you, meet Uthek the Wise, their shaman, on the outskirts of Gelkis Village in southwest Desolace. Until then, you are not welcome there. Uthek says you tread on Gelkis earth. Prove your friendship by killing Magram centaur, then return when their blood has soaked the ground.

sections.title: Uthek's Word
sections.body: Uthek the Wise says the earth tells how many Magram you have killed. He says this is good. As a friend of the Gelkis, you may take on more work from Uthek.

faq.q: Who proposes an alliance with the Gelkis?
faq.answer: Gurda Wildmane proposes turning the centaur clans' hatred against them. Ally with one clan, and you can learn how to defeat them all.

faq.q: How do you earn the favor of the Gelkis?
aliases: how to get friendly with gelkis
faq.answer: Kill the Magram, the clan the Gelkis hate most, to earn their favor.

faq.q: Who do you speak to among the Gelkis?
faq.answer: Speak to Uthek the Wise, a Gelkis shaman, on the outskirts of Gelkis Village in southwest Desolace.

faq.q: What does Uthek require before welcoming you?
faq.answer: Uthek says you are not welcome on Gelkis earth until you prove your friendship by killing Magram centaur.
